_about: Building dimensions for tools/build_factory_shell.mjs. Change a number, run `node tools/build_factory_shell.mjs`, reload /v2. Values come from the site video of 2026-11-09 (docs/SITE_REFERENCE_2026-11-09.md); 'confidence' says how sure each one is. X = length (0 = far end wall, increasing toward the office end), Y = width (0 = the wall with the entrance, Y max = the wall with the cargo doors), Z = up. Metres.

door._note: the animated sectional gate from the original model (3.8 m wide, 4.2 m high) on the cargo-door wall, in the 5th bay from the far (X = 0) end like the real 12 x 12 ft door

structures._about: The big built-in structures seen in the video, at the office end of the entrance wall. Every piece is a separate, editable building part in the viewer. Positions are estimates from the video (see confidence.structures).

mezzanine._note: second-floor office over a chain-link cage; from x0 to the end wall, from the entrance wall to the centre post line

stair._note: straight black steel stair on the hall side of the mezzanine, rising toward the entrance wall; cream panel on the hall side

restrooms._note: two rooms between the stair top and the entrance wall, both doors facing the hall

entrance._note: glass double door in the entrance wall, right beside the restroom block

confidence.bayM: high — 354 px between wall columns in a frontal frame, scaled by the 12 ft door, the man door and the 2.4 m wainscot (all three agree): 7.62 m = 25 ft
confidence.eaveM: high — same frame: wall top 5.9 to 6.1 m = 20 ft
confidence.widthM: medium-high — the stair foot is 18.7 m and the wall beyond the stair top 29.7 m from the cargo-door wall (three frames agree), and the end wall measures about 30.4 m by its wainscot: 30.48 m = 100 ft. (An earlier reading of 45.72 m was wrong: part of a side wall was mistaken for the end wall.)
confidence.postLinesM: medium-high — one interior post row 14.5 m from the cargo-door wall = the centre line of a 100 ft building
confidence.lengthM: medium — 5 bays from the far end to the sectional door column, the door/roll-up bay, and about 2 more to the office end: 8 bays = 200 ft. Could be 7 bays (53.34)
confidence.roofSlope: low — looks like a low-slope 1:12 metal building roof
confidence.structures: medium for where they are (stair hall-side face at X about 40 to 41 and 18.7 to 22.5 m from the cargo-door wall; restroom doors beside it toward the entrance wall; entrance door next to the restroom corner); low for the mezzanine length and for sizes that were not directly measurable (restroom depth, office wall height)
